title: New Year: health first, career second
oneliner: Fix your health and your goals in parallel - better health is what powers better work.
says: A New Year message: focus on your life first and work comes next. Prioritize health - good thoughts, workout, meditation, yoga - and in parallel fix your goal, identify your purpose, and work toward it. When your health is better, you work better. Balance the two.
explained: A short personal entry in the archive, and worth keeping because it explains the cadence of everything around it. His framing - health as the platform that career runs on - is the same systems thinking he applies to cloud architecture: the workload is only as reliable as what it runs on.
For the purposes of this site, treat it as a breather between the technical runs - and a reminder from him that the point of the career advice is a working life, not just a working resume.
takeaway: Sustainable careers are built on maintained health. The two goals are parallel tracks, not competitors.
